北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天湿润，体感稍闷。保持心情愉悦，注意防潮！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and humid in Beijing. Stay cheerful and mind the dampness!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪很热，体感38℃。多喝水，小心中暑，注意防晒哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is very hot, feels like 38℃. Hydrate well, beware of heatstroke, and protect from sun!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天体感热，多补充水分，出门记得防暑防晒！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels hot and cloudy. Hydrate well, remember sun and heat protection when out!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨风大，出门带伞，注意防风保暖，别着凉了！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Light rain and windy in Guangzhou. Bring an umbrella, mind the wind, and stay warm!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云炎热，体感36℃。记得多喝水，注意防暑降温哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and hot, feels like 36℃. Remember to hydrate and cool down!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州今日高温，体感37℃。多饮水，小心防晒防暑呀！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is very hot today, feels like 37℃. Drink plenty of water and mind sun/heat protection!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天风力大，体感不闷。出门注意防风，保持好心情！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and windy. Feel comfortable. Mind the wind when you go out, stay cheerful!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗酷热，体感39℃。一定多喝水，注意防晒防暑！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and extremely hot, feels like 39℃. Hydrate well and protect from sun/heat!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉中雨湿度高，体感略闷。带好雨具，注意防潮哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has moderate rain and high humidity, feels a bit muggy. Bring rain gear and mind the dampness!
武汉.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴天炎热，阳光强烈。注意防晒，多喝水解暑哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and hot with strong sun. Protect from sun and drink water to cool down!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗酷热，体感40℃。多喝水，防暑防晒是关键！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and extremely hot, feels like 40℃. Hydrate, sun/heat protection is key!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云稍热，湿度不低。保持舒适，注意补充水分！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and a bit warm, with moderate humidity. Stay comfortable and hydrate!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云微热，湿度稍大。保持好心情，注意防潮哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and slightly warm, a bit humid. Stay cheerful and mind the dampness!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云舒适，气温宜人。享受美好天气，保持好心情！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and comfortable, pleasant temperature. Enjoy the nice weather and stay cheerful!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云炎热湿度大。注意防暑降温，多补充水分哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, hot, and humid. Mind heat and cool down, remember to hydrate!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天湿度高，体感稍闷。注意防潮，保持心情舒畅！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and humid, feels a bit muggy. Mind the dampness and stay comfortable!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天稍热，湿度不低。出门记得带伞，保持心情好！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and a bit warm, with moderate humidity. Bring an umbrella and stay cheerful!
